text: Pinocchio ran home. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the fields. <break time="0.8s" /> As fast as he could. <break time="0.8s" /> He found the door open. <break time="0.8s" /> So he went inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Locked it. <break time="0.8s" /> And sat on the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he heard a small voice. <break time="0.8s" /> That said, Cri cri cri. <break time="0.8s" /> It was a big cricket. <break time="0.8s" /> That was climbing slowly up the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> I am the Talking Cricket. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have lived in this room. <break time="0.8s" /> For over a hundred years. <break time="0.8s" /> Boys who disobey their parents. <break time="0.8s" /> And run away from home. <break time="0.8s" /> Will never be happy. <break time="0.8s" /> Tomorrow I will run away. <break time="0.8s" /> Because I do not want. <break time="0.8s" /> To go to school. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Pinocchio. <break time="0.8s" /> Then learn a trade. <break time="0.8s" /> So you can earn your bread honestly. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Cricket. <break time="0.8s" /> The only trade. <break time="0.8s" /> That I like is eating, sleeping, and playing all day. <break time="0.8s" /> Pinocchio answered. <break time="0.8s" /> Poor Pinocchio. <break time="0.8s" /> I feel sorry for you. <break time="0.8s" /> Because you have a wooden head. <break time="0.8s" /> The Cricket said. <break time="0.8s" /> Pinocchio grew angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Picked up a wooden hammer. <break time="0.8s" /> And threw it toward the Cricket. <break time="0.8s" /> The room became very quiet. <break time="0.8s" /> And the Talking Cricket. <break time="0.8s" /> Said no more.
